sections.text: The Discovery Drone Kit is made possible through federal funding. Kits provide an opportunity for students age 8-12 to have a fun and educational drone experience.

This manual includes information about building the kit and flying safely. It also contains a troubleshooting reference and how to order spare parts. A printed instruction manual is included with each kit. View, download, and print additional copies here.

heading_path: **Discovery Drone Lesson Plan** *and printable flight log!*
sections.text:
This lesson plan is designed to take your students on an engaging, hands-on journey into the world of drone technology, aviation safety, and real-world problem-solving. Use the whole lesson plan or select individual activities. Examples:

- Practice safe drone operation, learn essential pre- and post-flight procedures, and maintain flight logs to monitor performance.

- Tackle real-world challenges that simulate drone delivery, payload lifting, and precision navigation.

- Innovate through redesign by modifying the drone’s structure to enhance stability, speed, or visual appeal—encouraging creativity and engineering mindset.

Use these cards in a variety of ways! The deck includes a mix of flight challenges, knowledge questions, and blank customizable cards. To make the cards:

1. Download the file.

2. Print front and back (so that the card “fronts” are all the same).

3. Laminate (if desired) and then cut apart.
